He escaped and met Luffy, who had formed a small pirate crew, and became Luffy’s vice-captain in that pirate crew.
He returns to the Grand Line and begins a new journey with Luffy as his captain.
Lin Tian became accustomed to playing the role of a vice-captain who always made plans, had unreliable captains, and always acted before thinking what exciting things would happen…
rebirth-of-a-billionaire-heir:
Ethan Carter, a failed office worker from his past life, wakes up as the spoiled heir of the Carter family—a young man infamous for his laziness and scandals. Armed with the Cheat Investment System, which can predict future market trends, Ethan sets out to transform his life from a disgrace to a legend.
As he climbs the ladder of success, Ethan must face ruthless rivals, scheming family members, and the brutal corporate world. With each step forward, his empire grows larger, but so do the stakes. Will Ethan use his newfound power to crush his enemies and secure his legacy, or will his ambition lead to his ultimate downfall?
Follow Ethan’s journey from a “worthless heir” to a world-changing tycoon in this epic story of wealth, betrayal, and redemption.
rebirth-of-a-village-girl:
Ni Yang, a modern businesswoman, is reborn in her seventeenth year.
The year is 1983.
In an era that favors boys over girls, Ni Yang revises her tragic fate from her previous life, skirmishes in the mall, and overcomes the most challenging obstacles, achieving success step by step – a radiant progress.
Observe how Ni Yang, with her petite but capable hands, overturns her fate from an ordinary rural girl to become the richest woman of her time.
However, in the process of building her wealth, Ni Yang inadvertently attracts the attention of a mysterious magnate.
So, the aloof and mysterious magnate in the eyes of outsiders transforms into a devoted husband, becoming an outright ‘wife slave’.
From then on, ‘wife is Heaven’, ‘serving wife is duty’.
This story is also known as “The Years When the Female Lead Conquered”.
seized-by-the-system: Procrastinator extraordinaire, Fang Ning, had lost his consciousness after banging his head on a night of celebration. He woke up to a realization that he no longer had control of his body, as a System had taken it over. Will he eventually regain control of his body or will he be trapped in his body forever? How does he maneuver this situation? What’s in store for Fang Ning?
shackles-of-humanity:
In a mysterious and bizarre world, amidst a human civilization stripped of electricity,and within a brutal, chaotic era where human lives are as cheap as grass—Luo Kai struggled desperately to survive as a lowly prisoner.
Pain and agony tempered his will; the flames of war and endless slaughter forged his growth.
When he finally looked back, he realized he had already become one of the most powerful lifeforms in this entire world.
signing-in-at-mount-sword-for-100-years-:
Lin Ran was transmigrated to a fantasy world and was the top scorer during the martial arts exam.
He was assigned to protect the empress, but because he did not give presents to the general director in charge of the palace affairs, he was demoted to a guard at Mount Sword.
His only job was to clean the swords stored on the mountain.
[You have cleaned the broken sword, Fire Stream. You have been rewarded with 50% proficiency of the Heaven Fire Sword Will.]
[You have cleaned the heavy sword, Dragon Elephant. You have been rewarded with the inner energy of the Dragon and Elephant Divine Art.]
[You have cleaned the demon sword, Dark Wind. You have been rewarded with the Grade 9 method, Phantom Step.]
[You have cleaned the spirit sword, Heaven’s Chance. You have been rewarded with the Eyes that Peek into Heaven.]
“Isn’t this way better than working as the empress’s guard?” Lin Ran quickly decided to remain on the mountain until he had become invincible.…
sinner-of-cultivation-world-steals-toxic:
Depressed by life, disappointed with relationships, and piles of regrets, just when Shaan was at the end of his rope, his soul was offered another shot at salvation!
Starting afresh in an unfamiliar place, by sheer luck, Shaan stumbled upon a treasure that could help him hop between zombie and cultivation worlds.
“There is shortage of food and resources in the apocalyptic world?”
-“It’s okay, I will ship them from another world.”
“You said, a zombie horde is coming?”
-“It’s okay, I shall call my undead legion.”
Facing countless vicious zombies alone that could bring goosebumps, Shaan stood defiantly with a crazy greed in his eyes.
With amazing new powers….Turning his blissful desires into reality, becoming an overlord overnight, and buying to your heart’s content, Shaan’s new life shall be perfect.
And if someone stands against his eccentric dream?
Then, Shaan is sorry in advance for sending them to the afterlife!

slime-evolution:
Lohan lived his entire life in a hospital bed, needing machines even to breathe.
Then one day he woke up on a parallel Earth, where he had a perfectly functional body, but with the disadvantage of being from the Lower Zone, without the right of clean water to drink or pure oxygen to breathe, and with an huge debt in his name.
Fortunately, there was something that would change his destiny.
A new VRMMORPG had been released two days prior, and there, if someone put in the effort or was lucky enough to acquire a Rare Class or Race, their destiny could change overnight.
And Lohan was one of the lucky ones who not only achieved a race above the “Common” level, but the highest level available, a Mythical Race! And the most unbelievable thing is that his class, Devourer, was also a Mythical Class, something completely unimaginable.
The problem is that his race was that of a simple Slime!
Spawning in the middle of a forest, without any guide or tutorial, Lohan had to explore the potential that his Mythic Class and Race held.
Using the Absorption ability to devour enemies, steal stats, traits, and overcome any limit, the Slime evolved.…
smash-all-pots-and-pans-to-go-to-school:
The former top engineering student Wei San transmigrated into an interstellar child who was deprived of education. By picking up garbage and turning waste into treasure, she finally saved a sum of money before the opening season of school and immediately signed up.
She planned to become a Mecha Engineer in the future. It was said that it can make a lot of money and was closely related to her own original specialization. Plan pass √
Unexpectedly, because of her greed for cheap tuition fees, Wei San reported to the wrong major and became a mecha individual fighter——those violent maniacs who licks blood all day
Wei·Gentle & Quiet·Impoverished·Engineer: “……”
However, the environment could not make her give in, and Wei San decided to learn by herself in her spare time.
During the training period of a certain competition, the media interviewed and photographed the individual fighters of each school in turn, which was broadcast live on the whole interstellar network. The audience could see that everyone was training desperately, such as gravity pressurization, close combat, long-distance entanglement and so on.
【YY’s melee is too strong.…
spoiled-by-the-young-master-after-reborn:
In her past life, she was his personal physician, his junior,
Due to the age difference, she could only bury her love for him deep in her heart.
An explosion awakened her, and she found herself back in his era.
When they met again, he was the noble and aloof scion of his family,
She was a village girl with a tragic background.
But this time, she would not shrink back,
She would bravely pursue her love, making this second chance at life devoid of regrets.
In public, he was cold and ruthless,
In private, he was a devoted lapdog to his wife,
His maxim was, “What the wife says is always the truth.”
This story is a one-to-one relationship, with both parties being virtuous and strong.
stormwind-wizard-god:
In Azeroth, a young man, touched by arcane energies, embarks on an extraordinary journey. Driven by an unyielding pursuit of love and justice and a staunch refusal to become a mere ghoul, he seeks to reclaim lost justice and restore humanity's fading light. thank-you-for-waiting-mister-tang:
Forced out by her step-mother, she was driven to desperation and had no way of surviving other than to sign herself away and marry herself into a rich and influential family.
Three years into the marriage, her wealthy husband had spoiled her to heavens.
The only problem was that they had no inheritors in their family.
Inside the luxurious mansion, Pei Qiqi angrily threw a stack of newspaper onto the man, “The article is claiming that I am a hen who cannot lay eggs! But Tang Yu, it’s you who has issues!”
The man put down the newspaper and agreed to what his young wife was saying, “Why would they write false information? Your zodiac is the pig!”
“Tang! Yu!” She stomped her feet out of anger.
The man grinned, “So what we have no kids? You are my little baby.”
Pei Qiqi thought, how did this scene change so fast!
the-anomalys-path:
Life.
People say it has meaning. Purpose. Some grand reason you’re supposed to figure out before it’s over.
Honestly?
I think that’s bullshit.
Some people are born strong. Some are born lucky. And some of us are born just… there. Not special enough to matter. Not useless enough to disappear.
I tried. I really did.
School. Family. Dreams.
Didn’t work out.
So I ran. From expectations. From people. From myself.
And somehow, I ended up here.
Inside a game I used to play.
The Hero Chronicles.
Famous for being unfair. Famous for being impossible.
And now I’m part of it.
Not as the chosen hero.
Not as someone important.
Just Leo von Celestial.
The human Domain's failure.
And the worst part? I've got 40 days until the Path Awakening.
The same trial that killed the original Leo in the game.
Now it’s my turn.
the-blind-lover:
Qin Yu had lost both her parents when she was young and was all alone. Since then, she lived with her father’s comrade-in-arms.
Due to the huge inheritance that her father had left behind, her foster mother had attempted to murder her repeatedly. In order to survive, she could only pretend to be a mentally disabled child.
It wasn’t easy for her to reach adulthood, yet her foster mom wanted to marry her off to a powerful and influential family.
She heard that her fiancé was blind and had a violent personality.
However, no matter how ruthless he was, was he as ruthless as her foster mom?
In order to escape from this terrifying family, she decisively agreed to marry that person in her sister’s place.
Soon, news of a fool marrying a blind man spread like wildfire.
Their marriage had become the hottest laughing stock locally.
However, after she married him, she realized that everything was not what the rumors said.
Her husband was not blind at all, and he was not cruel. He was gentle and refined, and he treated her like a treasure.
And she wasn’t mentally deranged. She’d only pretended to be a fool to flee from her foster mom’s attempted murders.…
the-ceos-billion-dollar-bride:
When she agrees to help her friend out in a blind date, she never imagined it would lead her to the one man she'd hoped never to encounter again—her child's father.
Her first instinct? Run. But life has other plans, and she finds herself inescapably drawn back into his orbit as his company's legal advisor.
Just as she's poised to resign, escaping the tangled web of personal and professional ties, she's cornered in his office by the man who is as relentless in business as he is in pursuit of her heart.
In a game of cat and mouse, she is faced with a choice: succumb to the undeniable chemistry that still sizzles between them or risk it all to maintain the distance she's fought so hard to keep.
the-empyreal-gem-master:
The World of Ephesus.
A vast world plagued by Breaches containing countless Beasts of Corruption.
A World on the brink of ruin as the Four Human Lineages defend the last bastions of Humanity!
With the power of Gem Masters standing against the Beasts of Corruption, the flames of Humanity seek to burn ever brighter.
In such a world, in the Mortal Branch of the Asmodeus Bloodline, Alexander awakens a Gem Socket that others consider defective.
A Variant Gem Socket.
Looked down upon by those who do not understand it, this supposed defect may just be the solution that the burning embers of humanity were waiting for.
Follow Alexander as he entirely warps the perception of what a Gem Master is- as he embarks on a journey to become...The Empyreal Gem Master!

the-reborn-king:
Alfred, a history teacher on Earth is suddenly thrown into the body of Prince Alfred Lindonfall, the twelve-year-old prince and heir to the throne of the Kingdom of Ammar. With the abrupt death of his father, the responsibility to rule a Kingdom falls on his shoulders. Having to navigate a medieval court and world, his journey to creating an empire and putting his knowledge into practice sees him become a man he never knew he could be, being shaped by the new world and unique circumstances he faces.

the-reincarnated-hitman:
Liam’s plan was as simple as it could get, retire, find a girl that resembled his favorite comic Heroine, Radiance, and settle down.
But for someone in his line of work, life was never so simple.
After completing one last job, his promised severance pay came in the form of three hundred of the world’s best hitmen.
A glorious death, if he did say so himself.
***
But unlike what he expected, death wasn’t the end, because the next moment, he found himself in the body of another Liam.
A broke, nineteen year old Liam, with two kids depending on him and a Pragma so weak the government felt sorry for him.
Ah, that’s right,
He reincarnated into a world of superheroes, but not just any world.
He’d somehow landed in the world of his favorite comic, which meant Radiance wasn’t fictional anymore.
All he had to do was get her attention.
Simple enough….. except rent was due, and the kids needed feeding.
So he did the only reasonable thing a retired hitman reincarnated in a superhero world could do.
He went back to work.
the-return-of-the-namgoong-clans-grandda:
I thought I had been abandoned,
But I was actually the child that the Namgoong family had been searching for.
It wasn’t until I was killed by the Blood Demon, whom I had called “teacher,” that I learned the truth. When I awoke again as a thirteen-year-old child, I decided to return to the Namgoong family.
I didn’t seek to be recognized as family.
I only wanted to prevent the Namgoong family from falling apart as it had before.
“This is the jewelry, silk, gold bars, and elixirs that the family head has gifted to you.”
“Here, little one. This is a congratulatory gift for your return.”
As soon as I was recognized as the lost granddaughter of the Namgoong family,
I gained delicious food, fine clothes, gold and silver treasures, and a high-quality sword!
I also gained a grandfather and a father who cried and laughed for me.
But what was that strange, tingling feeling in my chest every time that happened?
In order to protect the smiles of those I had once killed,
and to preserve this warm and ticklish sensation for as long as I could,
I was determined to change the bloody future that awaited me, unlike my previous life…
**
Namgoong Mucheon’s face darkened.…
the-speedrun-begins-with-choosing-hunter:
“The first principle of speedrunning: You must not die.”
“The second principle of speedrunning: Choice is greater than effort.”
Bai Yuan transmigrated. This world is overrun with demons, and life is precarious. Fortunately, his sister-in-law is very beautiful... He originally only wanted to live a peaceful life, until one day he awakened his golden finger.
[Swordsman] [Boxer] [Hunter]

Hunter→Demon Hunter→God Hunter.
the-unlimited-ascension-reborn-as-an-ext:

After losing his parents at a young age, Alen's life on Earth was a constant struggle. Pushed to the brink of starvation and unable to find work, his miserable life is suddenly cut short, only for him to awaken in a mysterious and deadly new world: the Ascension Realm.
Thrown straight into a series of bizarre and terrifying trials, Alen must rely on a unique path to stay alive—the 'Path of Selfish'. He quickly learns that in this brutal environment, kindness is a weakness, and only the selfish people can endure and survive.

Alen soon realizes that the ‘Ascension Realm’ is not just a temporary stage, but a vast, unforgiving world filled with constantly lurking dangers. With the odds stacked against him, his only choice is to face the deadly trials head-on and fight for his survival.…
this-marriage-will-surely-succeed:
Iona, the knight who was the loyal dog of the tyrant Emperor, gave her life for him. But her lord, whom she trusted, abandoned her in the end, and the person who stood by her side in her death was no other than her husband.
“I want to kiss you one last time.” Iona demanded on the verge of death.
“I’m telling you in advance… Just in case… You won’t die and this won’t be our last kiss.”
Satisfied with her non-lonely death, she closed her eyes.
When Iona woke up again, she realized that she had returned to the past and her husband was again chosen to be her partner.
Though her past wasn’t good, one thing she also didn’t want to change was her husband, the only success in her life. If so, she should at least turn this marriage into a ‘successful marriage’, she decided.
“Lord Leroy, I will formally propose to you; Please marry me. I will definitely make you happy.”
Iona was determined to repay her husband for his generosity. Just the way she wanted.
